paragraphs: Rabbi Abba the priest bar Pappa. Before Rabbi Yose bar Zevida (Tanchuma, Beha'alotekha). When he saw a group of people he went another way, so as not to trouble them to stand for him. Rav Yosef bar Zevida told him, “You must pass before them so that they will stand for you.” According to what Yuchasin writes—that Shmuel, Rav’s colleague and son of Abba bar Abba the priest, had a son called Rav Pappa—perhaps this Abba was his son, named after his paternal grandfather.
